Definition: properly, to be at home, i.e. (by implication) to be pleasant (or suitable), i.e. beautiful
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be comely, be beautiful, be befitting; 1a) (Pilpel); 1a1) to be comely; 1a2) to be befitting
